art_direction: Distinct, newly authored continuous illustrated European 1914 terrain. Muted sage greens, calm detail, diffuse light. No original game image inputs or pixel reconstruction. Rectangular overscan candidates; runtime mapping, clipping and shared six-edge joins remain pending.

assets.description: Quiet sage/moss meadow with fine grass and clover.
Dry straw/sage meadow with earth glimpses.
Sparse broadleaf woodland with open meadow.
Dense mixed broadleaf/conifer woodland with small clearings.
Unmarked gravel/macadam bend from bottom to upper right; both ends continue past canvas.
Quiet diagonal river from left to right; channel and both banks continue past canvas.
